provenance: Regression vector for match_start: two list items (e.g. two distinct AI Act Art. 3 definitions, as in the real corpus) that cite the same provision in byte-identical words must still produce TWO records, told apart by their own distinct match_start — never collapsed into one by a dedup key that only looked at the verbatim text.
